What the Community Reads: Hugging Face Paper Themes

Each month's most-upvoted papers on Hugging Face Daily Papers, grouped by theme, so you can see which topics rise, hold and fade. Upvotes measure community attention, not quality or citations.

No paper data has been loaded yet.
This page reads data/hf-papers.json, which is generated from Hugging Face by python3 scripts/import_hf_papers.py. Run it where huggingface.co is reachable, commit the file, then run python3 scripts/build.py.

How to read this, and what it does not show

  • Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers. Each month shows the top papers by upvotes at the time the data was fetched. Only titles, arXiv ids, counts and our own theme labels are stored.
  • Themes come from fixed keyword rules on each paper's title and Hugging Face keywords (listed in scripts/import_hf_papers.py), not from a human reading every paper. A paper's first-matching theme is its primary theme. Papers matching no rule fall under “Other”.
  • Upvotes skew toward papers from large labs and papers submitted early in the month. A month marked “in progress” (*) is still running, so its counts and shares will keep changing until it ends.
  • Counts for one month depend on how many papers the data holds per month, so compare shares and trends, not raw totals between very different months.
